category: currency exchange rate API (fiat, crypto and metals, with history back to 1999)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0, no card: 300 requests a month, 1 API key, 10 requests a minute, daily rate updates, latest and historical rates back to 1999; private use only.
free_tier.notes: Only successful calls count against the quota; validation errors and errors on the vendor side do not. Each date of a historical call costs one request, and one call takes up to 31 dates. The convert endpoint starts on Small at USD 9.99 a month for 15,000 requests; the range endpoint (JSON, CSV or Excel time series) starts on Medium at USD 39.99 a month.

per_object_cap.stated: up to 31 dates in one historical call; each date costs one request

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 300 requests a month bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.currencyapi.com/v3/latest and /v3/historical with the key in the apikey header or parameter; json, csv or xlsx output on the data endpoints
chaining: 300 requests a month is enough for a daily latest-rate pull and a few hundred dated lookups. For a monthly history pull, one historical call takes 31 dates at 31 requests.

limits.value: 300 requests a month on the Free plan
10 requests a minute on the Free plan, then HTTP 429 until the end of the minute
up to 31 dates per historical call, each date one request

limits_note: Bulk path: none on the free plan; the range endpoint (time series, CSV) starts on Medium. A free key can pull at most 300 dates a month through the historical endpoint.
binding_note: 300 requests a month ends first: the 10 a minute rate would spend it in 30 minutes.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up by email, or Google, GitHub or GitLab sign-in; the pricing page says no credit card is required. The email form has no field list in the captured text, so its fields are unverified.

reliability_note: Past the monthly quota or the per-minute rate the API answers HTTP 429; the free plan's minute headers count per gateway node, so the limit is 5 on each of two nodes.
confidence_note: Quota, rate, history and licence fields are read from first-party pricing, rate-limit and docs pages. No key was created, so no call was made against the quota.
